title: Minecraft's Arrow Airburst Claymore
description:
In this video we will learn about a tiny windcharge cannon that can accelerate a volley of arrows over a large area to deadly speeds. This new device takes the concepts we learned from a previous video about the portal claymore and applies them to a single dimension device with a diverse range of options to fine tune the arrow spread. We will also learn fundamental concepts of damage and armour to maximise the potential for using this device as a defensive weapon in PvP contexts such as on Lifesteal or Unstable SMP.
